subject.title: fix: reject invalid channel account selections

question: Should upgraded callers that explicitly name an invalid, disabled, conflicting, or channel-mismatched channel account now fail rather than silently deliver through another configured account?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes observable delivery behavior for existing automation; source-level correctness and live proof cannot decide the product compatibility policy on their own.

options.title: Accept strict explicit routing
options.body: Make invalid caller-supplied account selections fail clearly while retaining existing behavior for omitted and host-derived account defaults.

options.title: Preserve fallback compatibility
options.body: Keep existing fallback delivery for invalid explicit selections and narrow the change to diagnostics or opt-in strict behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept strict explicit routing
recommendation.body: Make invalid caller-supplied account selections fail clearly while retaining existing behavior for omitted and host-derived account defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author has the clearest implementation context and can route the explicit compatibility decision to the appropriate channel-routing owner.
